tools.name: music_local_resume
tools.description: Recover the SAME interrupted/failed RVC or YuE computation owned by THIS conversation. Inspect status and fix its cause first. RVC revalidates source/recipe/voice. YuE reconnects to its original prompt; restart_missing=true permits the frozen graph/seed/reference to run again ONLY after verified backend absence; restart_failed=true permits retry after a verified backend execution error has been investigated/fixed. Prior prompt IDs remain recorded. Keeps job_id, reuses active/completed jobs, never revives cancelled jobs or sends media. Input {job_id:string,restart_missing?:boolean,restart_failed?:boolean}.

tools.name: music_rvc_start
tools.description: Default for covering an existing song: preserve the original recording melody, lyrics, timing and accompaniment; locally separate vocals, convert to the configured character RVC voice and mix back. No YuE generation, no ASR/rewritten lyrics required. First search media_recent for the correct already-cached vocal recording in THIS conversation; use its asset_id if the song/artist/version matches. Download only when no suitable original is cached. Find and cache the correct vocal recording in THIS conversation. reference_start_seconds/reference_seconds select a passage; omit both for the full actual recording (single processing window up to600s; longer songs use explicit windows). Default complete voice notes; file/both only if requested. Real job_id has durable follow-up via music_local_status. For a named voice FIRST use voice_library_list/read. Pass voice_id and its voice_profile_id only if direct_rvc_cover=true. A GPT-SoVITS voice is accessible to the owner but cannot substitute RVC weights: use the matching engine or report the actual compatibility issue privately; never silently use a default or introduce an unrelated voice. Omission uses current default only when no specific voice is requested. A submission is not listening or delivery verification.

tools.name: music_sampling_options
tools.description: Read live native YuE semantic, ABC score and diffusion sampling parameters: meanings, actual backend limits/enums, workflow defaults. Read this before tuning music_local_start.sampling or original planning_mode; defaults are not capability ceilings. No song created. Input {}.

tools.name: music_service_status
tools.description: Read actual YuE bridge and generation backend health without creating or retrying a song. Use this for local health; web_fetch is public-only. When the managed local service is inactive, trusted owners can call music_service_start then recheck this status. Otherwise read shared project-yue.md and project startup docs, then use permitted server tools on the correct OS. Report diagnosis separately from verified repair. Input {}.

tools.name: music_lyrics_compare
tools.description: Compare one actual ASR lyrics window with a version found on the web. First web_search for song/title/artist lyrics and web_fetch plausible versions; then supply asset_id, lyrics_evidence_id of ORIGINAL ASR, candidate_url and candidate_lyrics copied from that page. Reads the page with permitted web_fetch to verify real text. Aligns the corresponding passage, not the whole song. Only >=88% match and <=12%/12 edits permits minor correction, returning a new lyrics_evidence_id and exact lyrics. Large differences reject this version; compare another. Does not certify artist/version or human accuracy. Never replace uncertain ASR with invented text.

tools.name: music_local_start
tools.description: Start local YuE ORIGINAL or SIMILAR-song resynthesis and durable follow-up. When the user has already agreed to an original song, a follow-up style confirmation continues that request: write suitable original sectioned lyrics and actually submit instead of ending with a promise. A theme without an explicit title can be interpreted creatively, not invented as a fixed existing song title. Only automatic_followup=true verifies a scheduled background continuation; do not create a duplicate task, and recover completed media via music_local_status without generating again. Choose a specific title and set duration_seconds to the requested actual duration with suitable lyrics; both delivers voice and the full original only when requested. Existing-song direct covers default to music_rvc_start; only use YuE reference resynthesis when the user wants a similar/new take or explicitly chooses YuE. Default native female; character/RVC only if explicitly requested. When the user explicitly wants YuE reference resynthesis, use cover with this conversation actual reference_asset_id, lyrics and lyrics_evidence_ids from music_reference_inspect/music_lyrics_compare. Keep original melody, rhythm, phrasing and lyrics; follow the music policy supplied in context. On reroll reuse the previously verified recording unless the user changes version; source choice and lyric/score alignment matter more than adding style prose. reference_mode=melody by default (full also available). reference_start_seconds and reference_seconds select the source passage; explicit0 retains intro. Supply words matching that exact passage, preserve musical line breaks/sections, never blindly concatenate overlapping ASR windows. duration_seconds10..600 default60 is a generation ceiling. min_duration_seconds defaults90% of target, explicit0 allows preview; do not pad/stretch. text_guidance_scale0..100 controls native style/lyrics CFG (cover2, original1); stronger is not necessarily more faithful. seed fixes a take; omit for new take. Default complete voice notes<=60s; both only if requested. Result job_id is submission evidence, not audio quality or delivery. Query music_local_status for actual duration and sampled listening; media_reuse resends exact originals.

vocal_gender_request.description: Exact current-user quote explicitly requesting male singing, required for male

tools.name: music_reference_inspect
tools.description: Inspect exact cached audio from THIS conversation before covering, rerolling or recovering a take. Returns submitted style/lyrics/seed when this is a known generated song. Optional transcribe=true calls configured ASR for <=60 seconds at offset_seconds; candidate transcript is uncertain, not guaranteed lyrics. Pass lyrics_evidence_ids to inspect combined timing/order/duplicate boundaries BEFORE generating; coarse ASR equality is not word-to-note alignment. Returns lyrics_evidence_id; pass it in music_local_start.lyrics_evidence_ids and copy the transcript exactly (section labels allowed). supplied_lyrics may register words literally provided in the current user message, never invented words. Default original-recording covers use music_rvc_start, preserving the source without rewriting lyrics. YuE reference resynthesis is for a similar/new rendition or explicit YuE request, and then uses verified lyrics and source style. Use the exact quoted asset over another newer take. If only an original recording is available, listen/transcribe rather than inventing lyrics; if user demands unchanged accompaniment explain that YuE resynthesizes. Input {asset_id,transcribe?,offset_seconds?,seconds?}.

tools.name: music_local_status
tools.description: Read a local job owned by THIS conversation. Completed audio defaults to COMPLETE voice notes (each at most60 seconds), not a preview or file. User can request original file later via media_reuse. Never ask whether a file is wanted. Put real media[].id in final media_ids. No resubmission. Input {job_id:string,kind?:voice|file}.
